features.title: Log Analysis & Forensic Investigation

features.title: Comprehensive Reporting & Compliance

personality.buyer: Administrators, IT teams, MSSPs, and organizations managing network security and firewall logs
personality.reasoning: Firewall Analyzer is a security and compliance product for technically literate buyers who value control, clarity, and operational confidence. The visual language should feel precise, audit-ready, and highly structured rather than flashy. Brand orange from Techjockey should be used as the primary hero and CTA color, while the rest of the palette stays disciplined with dark neutrals, soft greys, and white surfaces for readability and trust.

typography.heroFontSizeReason: The hero headline is 8 words, so it should stay large but not oversized. 56px preserves authority while keeping the composition balanced on a split layout.

colours.colourReason: Techjockey brand orange is used as the primary hero background and CTA color per rule. White cards, charcoal text, and light grey sections create a secure, premium enterprise feel without introducing an unrelated palette.

layout.heroReason: The product benefits from a split hero because firewall analytics can be illustrated through a dashboard UI shell, log streams, and monitoring cards. Orange hero background signals brand identity, while the right side can carry a PNG product visual with layered charts and floating metric chips.
layout.featureReason: The page contains multiple feature groups, so the first feature block should use a clean three-column grid for scanability, while later sections can alternate between split panels and spotlight cards to maintain momentum and stronger contrast.
layout.darkSectionFor: A narrow proof or highlight band can use a deep charcoal panel to showcase live monitoring, compliance, or trust metrics for contrast against the lighter feature sections.

personality.imageryDirection: Use a polished firewall monitoring dashboard mockup with log tables, traffic charts, rule-status cards, and alert indicators. Add floating chips for 'Real-time Monitoring', 'Compliance Ready', and 'Bandwidth Insights'. Prefer layered PNG UI visuals on the right of the hero, with subtle precision-line decorations, segmented panels, and small data badges. If secondary visuals are needed, use abstract security shells, not stock photos.
personality.designPersonality: A disciplined enterprise security aesthetic: crisp, audit-friendly, and technically intelligent. The page should feel like a premium network operations console translated into a clean B2B landing page, with strong hierarchy, precise spacing, clear proof points, and subtle interactive polish.
